chain.title: Reap Misconducted Souls
chain.desc: Spiritcallers drop four of these each, one more with Looting. Every spell focus this addon adds is built on them, so kill Spiritcallers on sight and bank a stack before you start ritual work.

chain.title: Bind a Spirit Hand Focus
chain.desc: An adept nether ritual on an Animation Core, 50 souls and four Ectoplasm. It summons two hands of soul energy that fight for you without being commanded, and casting it while crouching calls all your servants back to your side.

chain.title: Bind an Impish Focus
chain.desc: Adept nether ritual on a Biting Focus for 25 souls. It drags imps up out of the Nether around you before they are pulled back down. Do not spend it carelessly - the Requiem Focus is built out of this one.

chain.title: Bind a Soul Beam Focus
chain.desc: An expert nether ritual run on Goety's own Soul Bolt Focus, costing 100 souls plus a Mystic Core, a Magic Emerald and two more Misconducted Souls. It fires a sustained beam that deals magic damage to everything hostile in its path - the addon's answer to a crowd in a corridor.

chain.title: Bind a Requiem Focus
chain.desc: Expert nether, 100 souls, activated on a Spellbound Book, and it eats your Impish Focus along with a Ghast Tear. Souls gather around you one at a time and then charge a target and detonate. The top of this addon's spell line.

chain.title: Slay Engineers Until One Drops Its Mallet
chain.desc: Only Engineers from Illage and Spillage carry it, only a killing blow you land counts, and only about one in forty drops it - Looting barely moves that. Right click it to build one of the Engineer's three machines, left click your own machine to heal it, crouch-hit it to pack the machine back into its box. It survives every crafting recipe below and repairs on an anvil with an iron ingot, so one is genuinely enough.

chain.title: Box Up a Chagrin Sentry
chain.desc: A dispenser, redstone and smooth stone around the mallet. It becomes a turret that picks its own targets and fires arrows fast, then overheats for about ten seconds after roughly seventy-five shots. Make several to cover a base.

chain.title: Box Up a Hinder
chain.desc: Costs a Regeneration potion. It heals allied creatures standing near it, though never the undead, and needs a cooldown after a few seconds of work. Pair one with your melee servants, not with a necromancer army.

chain.title: Box Up a Factory
chain.desc: The expensive one - two iron blocks on top of the usual dispenser and smooth stone. It churns out a steady stream of tiny servants: explosive beepers, flying snipers and little poking robots. One is a battle on its own.

chain.title: Slay Ragnos for Mutated Flesh
chain.desc: Ragno is the mutated spider-thing Illage and Spillage adds; it burrows and surfaces next to you, so fight it where you can see the ground. Each one gives up one or two pieces of flesh, a little more with Looting, and it is both the brewing reagent for the mutation effect and part of the Freaky Robe - plan on killing several.

chain.title: Distil a Potion of Mutation
chain.desc: Two stages: brew Mutated Flesh in your Goety cauldron for 25 souls to get a Dark Potion, then run a magic ritual on that potion - gated behind the Ravaging research - with Raging Matter, Shadow Essence, a Poison Quill Seed and a Wither Rose. Right click a villager with the result and it becomes your own Ragno.

chain.title: Assemble a Pumpkin Bomb
chain.desc: A carved pumpkin, a clock, soul sand and TNT. A living bomb that walks off and detonates without chewing up your terrain - and one of the two bombs the Freaky Robe eats.

chain.title: Assemble a Skull Bomb
chain.desc: The same trick with a skull and Ectoplasm instead. Also non-destructive, and the second bomb the Freaky Robe ritual demands, so make at least one of each.

chain.title: Stitch the Freaky Robe
chain.desc: A magic ritual that swallows four Dark Fabric, two Mutated Flesh and both of your bombs, run on a Bag of Horrors - so kill a Freakager first, since that is the only thing that drops one. Wearing the robe you can use the Bag of Horrors without holding it, and you can throw iron axes; below half health with an axe in each hand it throws a whole barrage.

chain.title: Sew the Freaky Hat
chain.desc: Dark Fabric around a Soul Emerald and a carved pumpkin, and a plain bench craft for once. It stops thrown iron axes from being consumed - they only take durability - and cuts the damage you take while riding a Ragno that has not been stunned.

notes: This is a bridge addon: it needs BOTH goety and illageandspillage (jar illageandspillagerespillaged-1.2.8.jar in this pack) and adds no blocks, no structures and no world generation of its own. Almost nothing here is a bench craft - 11 of the 21 recipe files are type goety:ritual run on a Goety altar with a soulCost and a craftType (magic / necroturgy / animation / adept_nether / expert_nether), and one is type goety:brewing. Two rituals additionally require Goety's "ravaging" research. Any quest built from this chain must sit downstream of the player already having a working Goety altar and soul supply. Sources verified from loot tables: goety_spillage:misconducted_soul drops 4 at a time from illageandspillage:spiritcaller (inject/entities/spiritcaller.json); goety_spillage:mutated_flesh drops 1-2 from illageandspillage:ragno and from your own tamed ragno_servant; goety_spillage:engineer_mallet is a 2.5% killed-by-player drop from the Engineer (entities/engineer_extra.json, looting_multiplier only 0.01). VERIFIER NOTE: the chain originally carried three illageandspillage: ids as steps of their own (kill:illageandspillage:engineer, kill:illageandspillage:ragno, illageandspillage:bag_of_horrors). All three do exist in illageandspillagerespillaged-1.2.8.jar, but all three are already steps in illageandspillage.json, and a goety_spillage chapter emitting another mod's item task is the wrong owner for them. They were folded into the goety_spillage steps that actually depend on them - the Engineer kill into engineer_mallet, the Ragno kill into mutated_flesh, the Bag of Horrors into freaky_robe - with the slay verb kept in the title so the player is told to fight, not to search. goety_spillage:engineer_mallet overrides hasCraftingRemainingItem/getCraftingRemainingItem (see EngineerMalletItem.class) so the three machine packages return the mallet instead of eating it, and its repair material is INGOTS_IRON - the claim that one mallet is enough is confirmed from the class, not assumed. The mod ALSO adds four summonable servants with no item form - Bound Engineer, Bound Freakager, Zombie Absorber and Crocofang - each a goety:summon_tamed ritual keyed to an activation item (engineer_mallet, bag_of_horrors, goety:great_hammer, goety:animation_core respectively). They are deliberately not chain steps because their only item ids are creative-only spawn eggs; they are listed under collections instead. Item descriptions were taken from the mod's own Patchouli pages under assets/goety/patchouli_books/black_book/en_us/, which is the author's documentation. Note the goety_spillage:mutation_potion ritual's activation item is a vanilla minecraft:potion with NBT {Potion:"illageandspillage:mutation"} - the "Dark Potion" the advancement refers to - so it cannot be expressed as a bare item id.
